capabilities: Renders a code block as a row of open-in buttons
Opens directories and files in Finder, terminal, or any CLI app
Merges per-block overrides onto global button defaults
Spawns detached argv arrays with no shell interpretation
Creates missing directories from the widget
extras: Desktop only; spawns local executables. Exposes a public API at globalThis.openers.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open a note's file or folder in Finder, the terminal, or an external editor, so users hand-write fragile file:// links.

requires.name: CLI app such as zed or cursor (only for command buttons)

summary: Code-block widget rendering one line of buttons that open a file or folder in Finder, the terminal, or any CLI app, with global and per-block overrides.
